Let
\(v_{1} = \left( 5, \ -10\right)\), \(v_{2} = \left( -15, \ 7\right)\).
be two vectors in the plane. Find the vector \(v\) having the following scalar products::
\(\langle v,v_1\rangle = 35\), \(\langle v,v_2\rangle = 79\) .
Here, \(\langle \cdot, \cdot \rangle\) is the scalar product.
